name: node-red-alephscript-sdk
description: SDK monorepo: Node-RED contrib nodes and a web UI (GamificationUI) for AlephScript

scripts.build:all: npm run build:core && npm run build:contrib && npm run build:firehose && npm run build:escribiente && npm run build:rooms && npm run build:ui
scripts.test:all: npm run test:contrib && npm run test:escribiente && npm run test:rooms && npm run test:ui
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:contrib && npm run lint:escribiente && npm run lint:rooms && npm run lint:ui
scripts.lint:fix:all: npm run lint:fix:contrib && npm run lint:fix:ui
scripts.install:all: cd packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript-core && npm install && cd ../node-red-contrib-alephscript && npm install && cd ../node-red-contrib-alephscript-firehose && npm install && cd ../node-red-contrib-alephscript-escribiente && npm install && cd ../node-red-dashboard-2-alephscript-rooms && npm install && cd ../node-red-gamify-ui && npm install
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:core && npm run clean:contrib && npm run clean:firehose && npm run clean:escribiente && npm run clean:ui
scripts.install:node-red: npm run build:contrib && npm run build:firehose && npm run build:escribiente && npm run build:rooms && cd ~/.node-red && npm install @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard $PWD/packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript $PWD/packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript-firehose $PWD/packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript-escribiente $PWD/packages/node-red-dashboard-2-alephscript-rooms
scripts.install:node-red-win: npm run build:contrib && npm run build:escribiente && npm run build:rooms && cd /c/Users/%USERNAME%/.node-red && npm install @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard $PWD/packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript $PWD/packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript-escribiente $PWD/packages/node-red-dashboard-2-alephscript-rooms
scripts.install:node-red-auto: npm run build:contrib && npm run install:node-red-detect
scripts.install:node-red-detect: node -e "const os=require('os'); const path=require('path'); const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); const nodeRedDir = path.join(os.homedir(), '.node-red'); const pkgPath = path.resolve(__dirname, 'packages/node-red-contrib-alephscript'); if(fs.existsSync(nodeRedDir)) { console.log('Installing to Node-RED at:', nodeRedDir); console.log('Package path:', pkgPath); cp.execSync('npm install \"' + pkgPath + '\"', {cwd: nodeRedDir, stdio:'inherit'}); console.log('✅ Installation completed!'); } else { console.error('❌ Node-RED directory not found at:', nodeRedDir); process.exit(1); }"
